# langsmith_gateway_spend_cap (Resource)

Manages an organization-scoped LangSmith LLM Gateway spend cap policy (`spend_cap`).

Spend caps block gateway requests once accumulated LLM spend exceeds `limit_usd` within `window`. This resource manages explicit per-subject caps, not `default_spend_cap` templates.

~> **Subject matchers are the identity of a cap.** The API upserts on them: creating a cap whose `subject_matchers` already belong to another cap in the organization updates that cap in place and returns its ID rather than creating a second one. Give every `langsmith_gateway_spend_cap` a distinct subject, or two resources will manage the same policy and fight over it on every apply. An apply can likewise adopt and overwrite a cap created outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_gateway_spend_cap" "workspace_monthly" {
  name        = "workspace monthly"
  description = "Cap production workspace spend"
  window      = "monthly"
  limit_usd   = 100

  subject_matchers = [{
    key   = "workspace_id"
    value = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `limit_usd` (Number) Maximum USD spend allowed in the selected window. Must be greater than 0; the API does not reject a zero or negative limit, which would block every request.
- `name` (String) Human-readable policy name.
- `subject_matchers` (Attributes Set) Subject matchers that select which requests share this spend limit. All matchers must use the same key; multiple values for that key are ORed. At most 10 matchers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subject_matchers))
- `window` (String) Spend window: `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, or `monthly`.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Enforcement action when the policy is triggered. Currently only `block` is supported, which is also the default.
- `description` (String) Optional policy description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enforced. Defaults to `true`.
- `priority` (Number) Policy priority. Lower values take precedence when multiple policies match. Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `current_spend_usd` (Number) Spend accumulated in the policy's active window, when available.
- `id` (String) Spend cap policy ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns the policy.
- `parent_policy_id` (String) Parent `default_spend_cap` ID when this policy was materialized from a default. Null for explicitly managed caps.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--subject_matchers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subject_matchers`

Required:

- `key` (String) Matcher key: `organization_id`, `workspace_id`, `user_id`, `api_key_id`, or `run_rule_id`.
- `value` (String) Matcher value for the selected key.
